# Editotsu 0.7.0-alpha01

> **Alpha pre-release, not tested on a phone yet.** Unit tests pass, but nothing new in this build has been checked on a device. Expect bugs; report them on GitHub.
>
> Version: `0.7.0-alpha01` (`1700001`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates 0.6 builds in place. The 0.6 alphas were mislabelled as β; the name and icon are right now.

## Notifications work

New-episode notifications have been mostly broken since Dantotsu. Three reasons, all fixed:

- The app only asked for notification permission when you downloaded something. Now it asks when you tap the bell.
- New episodes went to a silent channel. They make a sound now.
- Subscriptions pointed at a source by its place in your extension list, so installing an extension sent the check to the wrong one. Subscribe again (bell off, then on) to pin your current source by name.

Settings → Tracking → Notifications shows whether Android lets the app notify you.

## Episode lists open instantly

A show opens with the episode or chapter list from your last visit while the source loads, then tells you how many are new. If the source has a bad day and returns nothing, you keep the old list.

## Openings and endings

- Theme audio keeps playing with the screen off, with previous/next on the lock screen. Theme radio while you cook.
- Openings and endings are proper lists now: full song title, artist, episodes. Songs with several versions show "v2 of 3" and expand in place.

## Settings, regrouped

Eleven screens became seven groups: **Appearance, Player, Reading, Sources, Tracking, Data and Storage, About.** Rarely used options hide behind **Show advanced settings** at the bottom of each screen. Search knows where everything moved. Your settings and backups carry over.

## CuNNy on Vulkan

The upscaler can run on Vulkan, which unlocks the bigger models (up to 4x24): your phone now draws lineart sharper than the studio had the budget for. If your phone's Vulkan driver refuses, the player falls back to OpenGL and tells you, instead of showing a black screen.

## Smaller things

- Pull down on the extensions list to check all repositories for updates. Empty lists now offer a button that fixes them (Show available, Add repository).
- Styled subtitles use the fonts their extension ships.
- Casting a torrent now tells you torrents play on the phone only, instead of a blank TV.
- The Android back gesture shows its preview everywhere, including back-to-home.
- The Discord and Telegram buttons led to Dantotsu's servers; they are gone.

## Known issues

- A torrent on a slow swarm can take up to 40 seconds to start, and long seeks are slow.
- The source picker can stall for a moment while many torrent results load.
- The biggest CuNNy models may stutter on some phones; pick a smaller one.
- AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show.
- Some streams use formats the player can't play; another source usually works.
- The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater.

## Which build should I download?

- `Editotsu-0.7.0-alpha01-google-arm64-v8a.apk`: Google build for most modern Android phones.
- `Editotsu-0.7.0-alpha01-google-universal.apk`: Google build for other architectures.
- `Editotsu-0.7.0-alpha01-fdroid-arm64-v8a.apk`: Degoogle'd build for most modern Android phones.
- `Editotsu-0.7.0-alpha01-fdroid-universal.apk`: Degoogle'd build for other architectures.
